data: Which method has the lowest CPU time on the PKU dataset when C is equal to 1 in graph (a)?

The question asks for the method with the lowest CPU time on the PKU dataset when C is equal to 1 in graph (a). From the caption, we know that the figure shows the average CPU time on the PKU dataset by varying C on five randomly sampled training and testing datasets. 

In graph (a), there are six methods represented by different lines: CRF(I2), CRF(I1), IRW-CRF, SVM^hmm, MTL^hmm, and OnlineMKL. We need to compare their CPU times at C = 1.

By visually inspecting graph (a):
- CRF(I2) is represented by the pink line.
- CRF(I1) is represented by the black line.
- IRW-CRF is represented by the light blue line.
- SVM^hmm is represented by the green line.
- MTL^hmm is represented by the red line.
- OnlineMKL is represented by the dark blue line.

At C = 1, the black line (CRF(I1)) appears to be the lowest among all the methods. Therefore, CRF(I1) has the lowest CPU time on the PKU dataset when C is equal to 1 in graph (a).
